If you’re looking for **carpet cleaning services in Melbourne**, here are some providers to compare. Customer reviews vary widely between companies, so it’s worth checking recent feedback, confirming the quote in writing, and asking about extra charges (stains, deodorising, moving furniture, etc.). [www.productreview.com.au](https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/melbourne-carpet-cleaning?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Recommended Melbourne carpet cleaners to consider

- Melbourne Vacate & Carpet Cleaning — Offers carpet cleaning and vacate cleaning services across Melbourne.   
- Omega Carpet Cleaning Melbourne — Carpet cleaning service operating in Melbourne CBD.   
- Urban Steam Clean (Carpet & Upholstery) — Provides carpet and upholstery steam cleaning services.   
- Black Gold Carpet Cleaning Melbourne — Carpet cleaning provider serving Melbourne areas.   
- Freshbreeze Cleaning Melbourne — Offers carpet cleaning services in Melbourne.   
- Allpro Cleaning Service Melbourne — Provides carpet cleaning and related cleaning services.   
- Cheap as Chips Cleaning — A larger cleaning provider with carpet cleaning services.   

### Before booking, ask:
- Is the quote **fixed price** or can extras be added?
- Does it include **steam cleaning, stain treatment, and deodorising**?
- How long will carpets take to dry?
- Are they insured?
- Do they provide an invoice/receipt (especially for end-of-lease cleaning)?

If you tell me your **Melbourne suburb**, number of rooms, and whether it’s **end-of-lease or regular cleaning**, I can narrow it down.
